title: What is React?
content: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces with reusable components.

title: Explain the Virtual DOM
content: The Virtual DOM is a lightweight copy of the real DOM that React uses to improve performance by batching updates.

title: What are React Hooks?
content: Hooks are functions that let you use state and lifecycle features in functional components.

title: What is the difference between props and state?
content: Props are passed from parent to child components; state is managed within a component.

title: How does useEffect work?
content: useEffect runs side effects after render; you can control it with dependencies array.

title: What is lifting state up?
content: Moving state to the nearest common parent component to share data between siblings.

title: Explain Context API
content: Context API allows you to share values between components without passing props at every level.

title: What are controlled components?
content: Components where form input values are controlled by React state.

title: What is code splitting?
content: Splitting your bundle into smaller chunks that can be loaded on demand to improve performance.

title: Explain reconciliation
content: React compares old and new virtual DOM trees and updates only the changed elements efficiently.
